verdict.rationale: Azure Cost Management documents budgets with alerts on both actual and forecasted cost, which keeps spending within a set limit. The Cost Management APIs also expose cost and usage data for programmatic monitoring. However, nothing in the pack shows documented spend anomaly detection, and nothing shows these controls are enabled or easy to configure from account creation. Missing for 10: documented anomaly detection on spend, evidence of day-one or default setup, independent or hands-on corroboration that budget alerts work.
